acceptance.body: Kuti ushandise Race Tracker, ndapota verenga uye ubvume Mitemo neMamiriro edu, uye uzive Mutemo wedu Wekuchengetedza Ruzivo.
acceptance.updatedBody: Takagadziridza Mitemo neMamiriro kana Mutemo Wekuchengetedza Ruzivo. Ndapota ongorora shanduro iripo kuti uenderere mberi.
acceptance.checkbox: Ndaverenga uye ndinobvumirana neMitemo neMamiriro, uye ndinoziva Mutemo Wekuchengetedza Ruzivo.
acceptance.failed: Hatina kukwanisa kunyora kubvuma kwako. Ndapota edza zvakare.
acceptance.outdated: Magwaro aya akagadziridzwa mushure mekunge app yarodha. Rodha peji zvakare, ongorora shanduro iripo, wobva waedza zvakare.

registration.required: Ndapota bvuma Mitemo neMamiriro neMutemo Wekuchengetedza Ruzivo kuti uenderere mberi.
